analysis.executiveSummary: This proposed 1-for-1 swap is a textbook win-win transaction aligned with both organizations' verified competitive trajectories. Corgi Loaf Baking Co., an Elite Contender with a explicit 'Win Championship' goal, sends 24-year-old Cam Skattebo to acquire 32-year-old Derrick Henry. Henry immediately elevates Corgi Loaf's starting RB1 position by +11.9 C-AVI points, securing elite goal-line equity and elite weekly scoring ceiling in Baltimore's offense. Conversely, Ravens Regime is in a 'Retool' phase; trading away an aging veteran back for a 24-year-old bellcow starter in Skattebo seamlessly de-ages their backfield by eight years without leaving a starting hole. AVI strongly endorses accepting this trade as constructed.
